messages:
Diego: Quick syncHeads-up: we're publishing an updated handbook section for benefits (401k tiers, parental leave payout examples, statutory sick pay clarifications). Need to run localization checks + a short manager ack flow. Iwant to collect blockers before tomorrow's office hours (11:00am PT).

Ivy: Noted. I added two scenarios to the tracker re: partial-year hires and contractors. @Liam please confirm contractor eligibility language we received a flag from eng about ambiguity.

Liam: Ill avoid ambiguous terms like "cliff" and suggest: "eligibility commences after 90 days of continuous service except where local law specifies otherwise." Will add inline edits by EOD.

Sora: Localization: EU markets require explicit statutory sick pay wording; also several APAC locations cap vacation differently. Ill add country rows in the spreadsheet and tag for local legal review. Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ExampleLink (internal)

Diego: Thanks. Managers need to ACK changes by next Friday. Priya can you export manager list and schedule reminders? Also include a short manager packet.

Priya: Yep. Ill export the active manager roster and send automated calendar nudges + an email with the manager packet at 4:00pm PT today. Will include a checkbox for local exceptions.

Ivy: Training plan: 20-minute microlearning video + 5-question quiz, pass = 80%. No live required but two office hours for edge cases. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

Kai: Works for me. Ill produce the microlearning and quiz. Recommend recording once and publishing at APAC and PST windows; I'll stitch captions and short transcript.

Sora: Ill run two live office hours: 11:00am PT and 11:00am SGT, and upload the recording. Also drafting a one-page FAQ for local HR partners.

Diego: For tracking, use columns: manager_ack_ts, localization_tag, and training_assigned. Managers mark ack and note exceptions. Priya please include a relocation flag so relocating hires get mandatory training assigned.

Liam: Legal asks: 1) Replace "benefits cliff" phrasing with the 90-day wording and call out statutory overrides. 2) Clarify PTO carryover vs local law and include examples for CA, UK, and Germany. 3) Add short clause on contractor classification not entitling to certain benefits (where permitted). I'll comment inline in the doc.

Ivy: Draft manager comms (paste below):
```
Hi managers,
Were updating handbook sections on benefits (401k, parental leave, sick pay, eligibility). Please review the manager packet and acknowledge by Friday EOD. Manager packet: <sheet link>
Thanks, Ivy
```

Diego: Looks good. Add short note about Redwood Console training credits and how managers can book vendor sessions with allocated budget. Priya please add booking steps to the packet.

Priya: Done added a training credits blurb and a one-click booking workflow. Ill attach the manager packet to the reminder email.

Sora: Also: flag compliance training as mandatory for relocating employees; will tag those on the sheet and add to relocation checklist.

Diego: Action list: 1) Liam legal edits inline by EOD, 2) Priya export manager list + reminders at 16:00 PT, 3) Sora add localization rows + schedule office hours and publish recording, 4) Kai record microlearning and build quiz, 5) Ivy finalize manager comms in sheet. Ill host the 11:00am PT office hour tomorrow to triage edge cases. :thumbsup:

Ivy: Ack.

Liam: Will comment in the doc.

Priya: Sending manager packet at 16:00 PT.

Kai: Recording scheduled, will upload to the sheet when ready.

Diego: Great work team closing the thread for now. If blockers pop up, drop here and Ill escalate.

Sora: See you tomorrow at 11:00am PT for office hours.
